5964.title: Plugin continuation errors escape process containment
5964.rootCauseOneLine: Process containment recognizes only service contexts, so stale API errors and detached CLI errors fall through to process.exit(1).

prReviews.topFinding: Adds stale-error containment and async handler attribution; linked draft was not executed.

5964.proposedFix: Contain stale errors by internal instance identity and carry exact-instance attribution through the common invocation wrapper.
5964.caveats: Test and both run outputs are inline per the reports repository policy. Child process mirrors the production dispatch; a full HTTP server and production incidents were not exercised.
